native_declaration.source: NCollection_LinearVector(size, value) delegates directly to Resize(size, value), which grows before copy-constructing every slot.
observations: size 1: capacity 2, one copy and no move.
size 3: capacity 3, three copies and no moves.
Second-copy failure: the incomplete vector construction does not run its destructor. The external fill value is destroyed, but the first copied tail object remains undestroyed in the raw allocation.

rust_mapping.behavior: with_value_ref constructs an empty vector and delegates to resize_with_value_ref; with_value is the owned adapter. Successful sizes 0, 1, and 3 have matching capacity, element values, and copy/move counts.
rust_mapping.known_gap: On a fill Clone panic, Rust drops any successfully cloned tail and deallocates partial vector storage; native leaves the incomplete constructor's raw storage and untracked constructed tail without cleanup.
